description: This file defines the Popup_Picker class responsible for generating a popup interface for selecting 'Releases' within the SuiteCRM system. It handles processing user queries, rendering the popup HTML, and managing interactions such as search and cancel actions.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: A class that manages the popup window for selecting 'Releases'. It constructs search forms, handles user interactions, and displays a list view of 'Releases'.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Generates SQL WHERE clause based on user input query parameters for filtering releases.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Handles the generation of HTML output for the popup, including search form, list view, and buttons, integrating various global components and templates.
